extDescription.message: Zen/Arc-style tools for Firefox: command bar, auto-archive, spaces, notes per page and boosts.

optAccessOk.message: Peek can work on all websites.

optAccessMissing.message: Peek needs access to websites to show previews.

optNote.message: Previews run in an embedded frame: on some sites you are not logged in there. “Open in new tab” always opens the real page.

optModeHint.message: Floating: looks like Zen, but on some sites you're not logged in. Popup: a small real browser window – always logged in, works on every site.

optCloseOnBlur.message: Close the popup when you go back to the browser

optUseLoginHint.message: Sends your normal cookies to the previewed site – only from the preview, only while it is open. Most sites then show you logged in; a few (e.g. YouTube buttons like Like) may still not work fully.

cmdSearch.message: Search the selected text in Peek

optSearchHint.message: Select text and press the shortcut, or right-click it → “Search … in Peek”. Change the shortcut in Firefox: about:addons → gear icon → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

kindHint.message: “With toolbar & extensions” opens a small normal Firefox window: address bar, extension buttons (uBlock, Dark Reader …) and everything else are there. “Slim” has no bars at all.

cmdPeekSearch.message: Search the selected text in Peek

cmdCopyUrl.message: Copy the address of the current page
